_note: Secret vault layout, in 1920x1080 pixels. Colours are [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a] from 0 to 255; text markup strings (<g.#top.#bottom>%s</g>) are glyph gradients. Opacities, shades and scales 0 to 1; angles in degrees.

loading._note: The text shown while the songs load.

name_tag._note: The dialogue's name tag holds ink_w px of ink at size font: a longer name gets a smaller font, down to min_font.

text_fit._note: A text longer than its max width shrinks down to fit_min of its size, then squeezes; box_pad (times the scale) is added to the squeeze width. Text fitted to a box tries scales box_step apart down to box_min_scale; a last line shorter than short_last_line of the box may shrink the text up to short_line_shrink more to save the line.

gate._note: The vault door, centred in the doorway at center (door_r is its radius; the doorway shows it within 304 px). Its bolts' centres are bolt_out from the door's centre when locked, bolt_in when drawn back, count of them from first_deg step_deg apart; each slides through a clamp guide_r out. The wall is centred at wall. The wheel's and the keys' shadows sit (x, y) off them at opacity. The keyholes, left to right, with each key's colour; an unowned key's name is shaded to dim_shade.

panel._note: The hint panel, top at top, centred on center_x, sized to its text between min_w and max_w: pad_x / pad_y inside, a name_row for the key's name, a hint_row per hint line (wrapping at hint_max_w), a status_row.

sea._note: The cabin and the sea behind its glass. Things in the sea are laid out in the room's space: x across, y down from the vanishing point (vanish_x, vanish_y), at depth z (1 = the glass; depth_px is the depth of z = 1 in px, so speeds along the walls are px / depth_px), half_w out to either side wall. floor_y is the cabin floor's screen row, desk_y the desk's (the chest stands on it), ceil_y the top bubbles rise to, kick_y the height the sea's things are laid out from, foot_y the row seaweed stands on behind the counter. The table's bottom centre at table. Fog turns things murky with depth (z_range) and distance behind the glass (d_range).

weeds._note: Seaweed out on the sea floor: side, distance behind the glass, depth, kind (Seaweed<kind>.png), height (px at z = 1). The sea floor falls away from the glass, so a weed's foot always stays hidden behind the counter.

weed._note: Seaweed is shaded by fog_shade of the fog, tinted (red, green, 1) and faded by fog_fade of it.

fish._note: A fish swims along a side wall, d behind the glass (picked in d, times one picked in d_spread), len long, at a height picked in y; from just off the screen's edge (near_half_w) to hidden behind the back wall's corner (far_half_w). Its art has art_pad px of margin; it tilts at most max_tilt_deg. Fog shades it (fog_shade), takes red and green out of it (fog_red, fog_green) and fades it (fog_fade).

bubble._note: A bubble rises d behind the glass at depth z, from rise_from_dy under kick_y, radius r; it goes once gone_margin above ceil_y. Fog fades it by fog_fade; it is drawn at opacity.

caspian._note: Mr.Caspian's feet (bottom centre) and his dialogue box (box and theme are handed to the shared dialogue library, its own key names, 0-255).

cards._note: The chest cards (Leave plus one per chest) around center_x: the front one at y, the next spread1 to its side, the ones after spread2 further. A card one place off is near_shrink smaller per place; further ones far_scale less far_shrink per place. Side cards are shaded by side_shade, drop side_drop px, turn rot_deg per place, and fade out from fade_from places over fade_over. On a card: the title at title_y (confirm_squeeze narrower when asking to confirm), the chest at chest_y scaled chest_scale, the stock message, the key chip at chip_y; on Leave, its label at leave_label_y. face_w is the card face's text width.

stock._note: The stock message, centred at y in a face_w x h box, shrinking down to min_scale to fit. On a side card it fades down to dim_opacity. kinds: its look by how much is left (fore and back are the text and outline colours, a shadow under it, its scale; light colours with a dark outline and a soft shadow on the parchment; nothing left is plain grey and smaller).

chip._note: A key chip: UI/Chip.png with cap px end caps (its middle stretches between them); inside, pad_l, the icon (icon_px wide; its art has icon_art_pad px of margin), gap, the count, pad_r.

top_chips._note: The top right chips, right-aligned at right, gap apart.

chest._note: A chest being opened, centred on x: drawn at scale, its art h px tall with the keyhole hole_y from its top. The key is drawn at key_scale once home; its shadow sits (x, y) off it, lift more per unit of extra scale, at opacity. A won key comes to rest at won_y. hit and kick_flash centre the punch's and the kick's impact flashes.

banner._note: The 'new key' banner over the won key: the title at y (fitted to title_fit, at most title_max_width), its shadow (dx, dy) off it, the key's name name_dy under it.
